title: 12-Lead ECG
author: W. Cole, MD
summary: Sinus tachycardia 116, PR 152 ms, QRS 90 ms, QTc 426 ms (Fridericia). No tall narrow peaked T waves, no loss of P waves, no QRS widening (potassium 5.8 at 0200). A normal-looking tracing does not exclude hyperkalemia.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 116 bpm. PR 152 ms. QRS 90 ms. QTc 426 ms (Fridericia).

**Interpretation**
Sinus tachycardia. No tall, narrow, peaked T waves, no loss of P waves and no conduction widening. No ST or T-wave pattern of ischemia, no arrhythmia.

**Context**
DKA with potassium 5.8 (released 0220). A normal-looking tracing does not exclude hyperkalemia, and insulin will move potassium into the cells while total body potassium is low. Continue cardiac monitoring; no potassium or bicarbonate now.
impression: Sinus tachycardia 116 without peaked T waves or QRS widening at potassium 5.8. QTc 426 ms.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: C. Lombardi, MD
summary: Sinus rhythm 92, PR 156 ms, QRS 88 ms, QTc 438 ms (Fridericia). Mild nonspecific T-wave flattening; no prominent U waves, no ectopy (potassium 3.4 at 1040).
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 92 bpm. PR 156 ms. QRS 88 ms. QTc 438 ms (Fridericia; any U wave is identified separately and not included in the QT).

**Interpretation**
Sinus rhythm. Mild nonspecific T-wave flattening with at most a tiny U wave; no prominent U waves and no ventricular ectopy. Compared with 0210: rate slower (116 to 92) and the T waves are lower.

**Context**
Potassium 4.2 (0640), 3.6 (0840), 3.4 (1040, released 1100) on the insulin infusion, with AKI on CKD. Replace cautiously, keep him on telemetry, and never infer a normal potassium from the ECG alone.
impression: Sinus rhythm 92. Mild nonspecific T-wave flattening at potassium 3.4. QTc 438 ms.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: C. Lombardi, MD
summary: Normal sinus rhythm 88, PR 158 ms, QRS 88 ms, QTc 424 ms (Fridericia). Normal T-wave contour; no ischemic or conduction change (potassium 4.6 at 1840).
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 88 bpm. PR 158 ms. QRS 88 ms. QTc 424 ms (Fridericia).

**Interpretation**
Normal sinus rhythm. Normal T-wave contour; no ischemic or conduction change, no ectopy. Compared with 1105: the T-wave flattening has resolved.

**Context**
Potassium 4.6 on the 1840 specimen (released 1900), after 20 mEq of potassium chloride. Continue telemetry.
impression: Normal sinus rhythm 88. Normal T-wave contour. QTc 424 ms.

title: 12-Lead ECG
author: C. Lombardi, MD
summary: Sinus rhythm 80, PR 160 ms, QRS 90 ms, QTc 422 ms (Fridericia). No peaked T waves or QRS widening despite mild hyperkalemia (potassium 5.2 at 1840); continue laboratory surveillance.
body:
**Measurements**
Ventricular rate 80 bpm. PR 160 ms. QRS 90 ms. QTc 422 ms (Fridericia).

**Interpretation**
Sinus rhythm. No peaked T waves, no PR prolongation and no QRS widening despite the mildly high potassium.

**Context**
Potassium 5.2 on the 1840 specimen (released 1900). This tracing is reassuring but does not replace laboratory surveillance: a repeat potassium is pending. Continue telemetry.
impression: Sinus rhythm 80 without peaked T waves or QRS widening at potassium 5.2. QTc 422 ms.
